settings.text: Milled accessories
Accessories & Spare Parts for GG Putters

Fine-tune loft with clubfaces, dial in balance with weights, protect the head with a cover, and keep everything serviceable with the spare parts kit and torque wrench — all milled to the GG standard and priced from €21 to €149.
Clubfaces
Clubfaces are interchangeable milled face inserts that change the loft and feel of a GG putter.
Swap the insert to tune roll and sound without buying a new putter: a higher degree adds forward loft for slower greens, a lower degree keeps the ball firmer on fast surfaces.

• Lofts: 1°, 2°, 3°
  • Milled to the GG face standard
  • Fits Antares and Orion
View product
Extra Weights
Extra weights are swappable head weights for the three-position balance system.
Moving weight changes the balance point and the natural arc of your stroke: heavier weights add stability, lighter weights increase feel. Bullet and flat shapes suit different placements.

• Light 1.19 oz · Medium 1.48 oz · Heavy 1.97 oz
  • Bullet or flat
  • 3 dedicated weight points
View product
Putter Cover
A putter cover is a fitted headcover that protects the milled head in the bag and in storage.
It shields the face insert and the head edges from knocks, bag rash and moisture, preserving the anodized finish between rounds.

• Shaped to the GG head
  • Protects face and edges
  • Everyday carry protection
View product
Spare Parts Kit
The spare parts kit is a complete set of replacement hardware for your GG putter.
It bundles the small components most likely to wear or get lost, so your putter stays serviceable for years and you are never off the green waiting on a single screw.

• Screws, weights and hardware
  • For long-term maintenance
  • Fits Antares and Orion
View product
Torque Wrench
The torque wrench is a precision tool that tightens weights and faces to the correct, repeatable spec.
Setting each component to the right torque prevents loosening during play and protects the threads, so every adjustment is secure and consistent.

• Pre-set, repeatable torque
  • For weights and clubfaces
  • Protects the threads

Buying guide
Which accessory do you need?
Match the upgrade to your goal — here is the fastest way to decide.

• Want more stability? Fit the heavy 1.97 oz weight (from €21).
  • Struggling on slow greens? Try a higher-degree clubface, up to 3° (€52).
  • Adjusting at home? The torque wrench sets weights and faces to spec (€63).
  • Protecting your investment? Add the fitted putter cover (€32).
  • Fitting clients? The Fitter Kit covers every head, loft and weight combination.
Fits Antares & Orion
All accessories are compatible with both GG putter models.
Set to spec
Use the torque wrench for repeatable, secure adjustments.
2-year warranty
GG products are covered against conformity defects.
Fast shipping
BRT in Italy, FedEx worldwide — within 5–6 business days.
Setup guide
How to customize your GG putter
In four steps you can rebalance the head and change the face — no specialist tools beyond the GG torque wrench.

1. Loosen the weight screws. Loosen the three weight screws using the GG torque wrench.
  2. Position the three weights. Place the weights across the three points to match your stroke arc — light 1.19 oz, medium 1.48 oz, heavy 1.97 oz.
  3. Set loft and feel. Swap the clubface insert (1°–3°) to dial in your preferred loft and feel.
  4. Tighten to spec. Tighten everything back to the correct torque with the wrench.
For fitters, pro shops & club builders
The GG Putters Fitter Kit
A professional fitting system that builds and tests every head, loft, weight and neck combination in a single appointment.

settings.text: Fit by feel, not by guesswork

content.label: h3: Fit by feel, not by gu

settings.text: With the kit on the bench, a player can compare changes back to back — blade against mallet, loft against loft, light weight against heavy — and immediately feel which setup rolls the ball best for their stroke.
A putter dialled in during fitting is genuinely made-to-measure, which typically means happier customers, fewer returns and a stronger case for a premium custom build.

FAQ
Accessories & Fitter Kit — FAQ
Quick answers about compatibility, weights, lofts, tools, pricing and the Fitter Kit.

accordions.title: Which GG accessory should I buy first?
accordions.content: For most players, extra weights (€21) give the biggest change to balance and feel; add clubfaces (€52) to adjust loft, and the torque wrench (€63) if you plan to adjust the putter yourself.

accordions.title: How do the three weights change my putter?
accordions.content: The weights sit in three points and shift the head's balance: the 1.97 oz heavy weight adds stability for a straighter stroke, while the 1.19 oz light weight increases feel; the 1.48 oz medium sits in between.

accordions.title: How many clubface lofts are available and why do they matter?
accordions.content: Clubfaces come in 1°, 2° and 3° (€52). A higher loft helps lift the ball into a smooth roll on slower greens; a lower loft keeps it firmer on fast surfaces.

accordions.title: Can I adjust the putter myself, or do I need a fitter?
accordions.content: You can adjust weights and faces at home with the GG torque wrench (€63): loosen, reposition, swap the face, then tighten to spec. For a full fitting across models, use the Fitter Kit.

accordions.title: Do the accessories fit both the Antares and the Orion?
accordions.content: Yes. The GG system is modular, so weights, clubfaces and necks are interchangeable between the Antares blade and the Orion mallet.

accordions.title: What does the Fitter Kit include and who is it for?
accordions.content: The Fitter Kit is aimed at fitters, pro shops and club builders. It carries two heads (Antares and Orion), three lofts (1°–3°), a weights kit (2 heavy, 2 light), necks (lie and offset) and the tools to build any configuration.

accordions.title: Are accessories under warranty and how fast do they ship?
accordions.content: GG accessories carry the same 2-year warranty as the putters and ship with BRT in Italy and FedEx worldwide, usually within 5–6 business days.
